title: Whole-text restructuring round of the pm-dispatch protocol face — maintainer-ordered, fires when the skills-lane backlog drains
body:
Maintainer ruling, 2026-08-22, live PM chat with the skills seat (session `session_01MsbKEG4LtERSLaDrbehM3e`), verbatim: 「所有的 skills 任务处理完之后，再来一轮全文重构」.

Context: the maintainer asked whether per-card edits to the protocol get holistic analysis; the seat's honest answer named the real gap — the ratchet caps VOLUME but nothing periodically audits CONCEPTUAL drift across the whole document as per-card edits accumulate. This card is the ordered remedy.

Restart-when: the skills lane has zero open `pm:queue` cards (other than this one) and zero `pm:dispatched` in flight

## Scope (the round, not the edits — the edits get their own ruling)

1. **Full-text analysis** of the protocol face: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` + its `references/**` + `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — read as one document set, in the state the drained backlog leaves them.
2. Produce a **net-reduction restructuring proposal** for the maintainer: redundancies (the same rule stated in two places), contradictions or near-contradictions left by accumulated per-card edits, prose that should sink from SKILL.md to references (principle-vs-mechanism layering), retired concepts still carrying words, and any clause whose exceptions have drifted from its statement.
3. The proposal goes to the maintainer as a decision digest BEFORE any edit — ⛔ the restructuring itself is not pre-authorized by this card; only the analysis round is. Implementation lands as governed draft PR(s) at `claude-fable-5` (clause ①), with the ratchet ceiling LOWERED to the post-shrink count in the same change (lowering is always legal).

## Constraints carried from standing rulings

- 「现有的项目经理skills 应该大幅简化，只需要说原则，不需要写细节」 (2026-08-12) is the direction of travel; details live in references, facts in the fact tables, enforcement in gates.
- 密度优化仅随净减内容的 PR 顺带 (2026-08-17) — this round IS the commissioned net-reduction, so the density work rides it legitimately.
- Every rule kept must keep its date + verbatim ruling anchors; ⛔ restructuring never rewrites a ruling's words.

Filed by the skills seat under the lane self-triage exception; `pm:on-hold` until the restart criterion fires (evaluated by the standing daily executable-criteria scan, or by this seat at any round boundary where the queue reads empty).
